headline: Priced through the morning: General Dynamics' pre-open raise is +2.0% after peaking at +3.9%
reasoning: Source: General Dynamics' Q3 release and call, via Benzinga Newsdesk 09:29 ET: 'Raises FY2026 GAAP EPS Guidance from $16.80-$16.90 to $17.20-$17.30 vs $17.00 Est; Raises FY2026 Sales Guidance from $55.700B to $56.500B-$56.800B vs $55.940B Est'.
What changed: the full-year EPS midpoint ($17.25) is 1.5% above consensus and the sales midpoint 1.2% above. A solid raise for a $102B defense prime.
Move from Thursday's 371.11 close: 378.41, +1.97% on 41,433 IEX shares. The high was 385.64 (+3.9%), and it has given back half. Three hours of trading have priced it.
objections: Pre-open news, priced through the morning; peak already faded.
